title: About Dataknobs - Integrated Platform and Services
description: DataKnobs' core innovation is its integrated "Kreate, Kontrols, Knobs" triad, a framework that manages the entire AI product lifecycle within a single, governed environment. This avoids the complexity and risk of using fragmented point solutions.
